images.scene: A hairdresser's workstation in a bright calm salon, seen straight on from chest height. On a plain warm off-white plaster wall hangs a large round frameless mirror with a warm LED halo glowing softly behind its edge, a gentle warm glow spreading on the wall around it; the mirror reflects only the bright opposite wall and soft window light, nobody in it. Under the mirror a floating shelf of pale oak with the tools of the trade neatly laid out: slim silver scissors, a black carbon comb, a compact black hair clipper, a round wooden brush, two amber glass spray bottles and one frosted white bottle without labels, a folded cream cotton towel, a small clear glass vase with a sprig of eucalyptus. Below the shelf plain wall and a light oak floor. Bright soft daylight from tall windows out of frame on the left, warm white grade, near-shadowless. The mirror and the shelf sit in the right half of the frame, the mirror centred vertically with plain empty wall above it in the upper quarter; the whole left half of the frame is plain empty pale wall and floor, large empty space for text. No chair, no people, no reflections of people, no posters, no text, no signs, no logos, no labels on the bottles.
